sentences.en: Innovation makes the difference between who leads and who obeys.
sentences.zh: 创新决定了领导者和追随者之间的区别。

sentences.en: Technological innovation brought about the rapid progress of the information industry.
sentences.zh: 技术创新推动了信息技术产业的迅猛发展。

sentences.en: A company that stifles innovation can't hope to grow very much.
sentences.zh: 一个抑制创新的企业很难有很大的增长潜力。

senses.zh: 改革, 革新, 创新 - 新观念, 新方法, 新发明 形容词: innovational

mnemonic: 词根记忆：in（进入）+nov（新的）+ ation→革新
